about: Scenarios for tools/mods/modtest.py (docs/mods/TESTING.md). Paths under 'install' are relative to --downloads. Westopolis tape, capture at game tick 1.2e9 (frame 1737) unless stated.

scenarios.name: cream-model
scenarios.what: A loose shadow.one from a .rar download replaces the player model; the game reads the mod's bytes and nothing else changes on disk reads

scenarios.name: conflict-tails-above-cream
scenarios.what: Two mods replace the same file; the higher one in the list is what the game reads

scenarios.name: conflict-cream-above-tails
scenarios.what: The same two mods in the other order

scenarios.name: texture-pack-android
scenarios.what: A Dolphin texture pack changes the picture and nothing the game holds: the end-of-run state equals stock

scenarios.name: eight-mods
scenarios.what: Eight real mods together (zip, rar, 7z, folders); 535 files with conflicts resolved by priority

scenarios.name: reloaded-data
scenarios.what: Reloaded's repository tree: its data loads and runs on the original code (no faults, every read accounted for); its code is offered, and nothing of it runs until chosen

scenarios.name: reloaded-voices-audio
scenarios.what: Reloaded's 37 voice entries rebuilt into the archive; 90 s of Westopolis audio equals stock (no replaced line plays there; moved entries are read correctly); every read of the switchable voice archive equals the port's composition of the rebuilt archive and the player's Japanese archive

scenarios.name: installer-refuses-damaged
scenarios.what: A damaged download (a third of shadow.one) is refused by the installer, naming the file; nothing is installed and the game plays stock

mods.install_must_fail: shadow\.one is \d+ bytes but its header says \d+ \(truncated

scenarios.name: truncated-file-skipped
scenarios.what: A model file damaged after installation (a third of shadow.one) is skipped at start-up with an error; the game runs as stock

scenarios.name: missing-dependency
scenarios.what: A mod that needs an absent mod does not load; another enabled mod still does

scenarios.name: damaged-state-file
scenarios.what: A damaged mods.json: the game runs without mods, says why, and plays exactly as stock

log_contains: \[mods\] error: mods\.json is not valid JSON .* running without mods

scenarios.name: master-switch-off
scenarios.what: Mods installed and enabled, 'Load mods' off: stock play

scenarios.name: no-mods-flag
scenarios.what: --no-mods with a mod enabled: stock play, no report written

scenarios.name: stage-chaotic-westopolis
scenarios.what: GameBanana 'Stages': Chaotic Westopolis (zip, 40 files: Westopolis layouts, stage archives, mission table, character models); the game reads the mod's layout and archives

scenarios.name: weapon-elephant-tank-cannon
scenarios.what: GameBanana 'Weapons': Elephant over Tank Cannon (7z, files/common/WeaponResource.one); the game reads the mod's weapon archive at stage start

scenarios.name: movie-op-re-edited-intro
scenarios.what: GameBanana 'Re-edited Intro' (7z, a loose Op.sfd): the intro movie the front end plays (cold boot, --ui-test select) is read from the mod and its picture differs

scenarios.name: movie-op-early-demo-intro
scenarios.what: GameBanana 'Early Demo Intro + Who I Am Opening' (zip, a loose Op.sfd): another intro movie; read from the mod, and its frame differs from stock and from the other intro mod

scenarios.name: effects-no-weapon-outline
scenarios.what: GameBanana 'Effects': No Weapon Outline, original version (zip, files/stg_cmn_gdt.one); the game reads the mod's common stage archive; at the capture the green glow under the weapon on the ground is gone

scenarios.name: text-retranslated
scenarios.what: GameBanana 'Shadow the Hedgehog Retranslated' v2 (7z, 1,247 font tables/glyph sheets, NTSC-U layout); the game reads the mod's Westopolis text, and at tick 400M Shadow's first subtitle shows the mod's wording (the only pixels that differ)

scenarios.name: save-file-refused
scenarios.what: GameBanana '100% Save File (Reloaded)' (zip, one .gci): the manager says it is a save (Reloaded's own file), installs nothing and writes nothing into the game folder; play equals stock

mods.install_must_fail: this download is a save, not a mod: 8P-GUPR-SHADOWRELOADED\.gci is a GameCube save \(game GUPR, maker 8P, file "SHADOWRELOADED"\)

scenarios.name: program-refused
scenarios.what: GameBanana 'ShadowRando' (7z, a randomizer program: .exe + .dll): the manager names the program, installs nothing, runs nothing; the game folder is unchanged; play equals stock

mods.install_must_fail: this download is a program \(.*ShadowRando\.exe\), not a mod: the manager never installs or runs programs

scenarios.name: reloaded-data-hud-tick
scenarios.what: Reloaded's data only, captured at tick 810M (HUD on screen): the base the code mod scenario is compared with

scenarios.name: code-no-hud-engine
scenarios.what: A code mod end to end: Reloaded's Gecko 'No HUD' chosen with 'ShadowModManager code', decided by build_variant.py --prepare-only (a data code: no recompile), run by the in-game engine on the stock executable; the HUD is gone against the same data without the code

log_contains: ^\[codes\] 1 data code\(s\) run once per retrace

scenarios.name: movie-wider-fmv-intro
scenarios.what: GameBanana 'Wider FMV's' (rar, all 8 movies re-encoded wider): the front end's intro Op.sfd is read from the mod and its picture differs

scenarios.name: movie-wider-fmv-story
scenarios.what: The same mod on the story movie: --boot-flashback plays E1001.sfd; read from the mod, picture differs from stock

scenarios.name: voices-japanese-xbox
scenarios.what: GameBanana 'Japanese Voices (XBOX)' (rar; installed: PRS_VOICE_E.afs, 78 sng_EV*_E.adx and 3 sng_jin_*_e.adx; left out: 7 Xbox 640x480 movies, 3 Xbox .pac banks): with the English voice setting the game reads the mod's archive as the English half of the switchable voice archive (every read equals that composition) and 90 s of Westopolis audio differs from stock

scenarios.name: voices-japanese-xbox-japanese-setting
scenarios.what: The same mod with the game's own Japanese voice setting (options.cfg voice=0): the port serves the player's PRS_VOICE_J.afs half, which holds the same clips as the mod's archive, so 90 s of audio equals stock with the Japanese setting

scenarios.name: movie-japanese-xbox-story
scenarios.what: The same mod's 7 movies are the Xbox version's (640x480; the game decoded E1001 into its 512x480 picture scrambled before this rule): the installer leaves them out, naming each, and installs the rest; --boot-flashback then plays the disc's E1001.sfd, picture and audio equal stock

install_must_say: left out: files/E1001\.sfd: is a 640x480 movie; this game's movies are 512x480

scenarios.name: control-model-equals-stock
scenarios.what: NEGATIVE CONTROL: claims Cream's frame equals stock; the frame check must FAIL

scenarios.name: control-wrong-winner
scenarios.what: NEGATIVE CONTROL: claims the lower mod wins a conflict; the winner check must FAIL

scenarios.name: control-texture-changes-state
scenarios.what: NEGATIVE CONTROL: claims a texture pack changes game state; the state check must FAIL
